title: FAA UAP reports, batch 04 (237UAP00082 - 237UAP00106)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports; only one report contains a claim of physical effects on an aircraft.

encounters.summary: LXJ359 reported a string of bright lights at FL550 while at FL450; experienced double Attitude Reference System and Autopilot System failures while underneath the lights.
encounters.quote: LXJ359 experienced a double Attitude Reference System failure and a double Autopilot System failure while directly underneath of the UFO lights.
